reviews.title: Deactivated my account, No warning.
reviews.text: This app wouldve been amazing. However I did not use my account for 8 months because I was moving, and not purchasing new records and when I finally unpacked and bought new records I was excited to go and log them only to find out my account had been deactivated. I never got an email notifying me that this would happen. I also emailed customer support and they tried telling me the timeframe had been longer than it was, and that they do send out emails. All they could do was basically dodge my evidence. Not once did they apologize or even really acknowledge what I was saying, just kept redirecting me to make a new account (and by the way, you cant reuse your same username once this happens.) Wasted hours of my life logging my entire library. Do better, discogs. Don’t even know what the purpose of deactivating accounts is, especially when its gone unused for less than a year.

reviews.title: App Is Broken
reviews.text:
iOS video player cannot be dismissed.

When opening a track/video from a Discogs release page in the iOS app, the video opens in a full-screen player. The × close button is visible but does not respond, and there is no other way to return to the release page. The only workaround is to force-quit the Discogs app and reopen it.

Steps to reproduce: Open a release → play a video/track → enter the video player → tap ×.

Expected: Player closes and returns to the release.

Actual: × does nothing and the user is trapped in the player.

Nice to haves for Discogs while I’m at it: please add a smart help page in running basic Python-script queries or Excel PowerQueries that work for the layman in order to download and sync one’s collection, in the most efficient manner.  Secondly, add more fields for downloads such as “Year” vice only “Released Year”, “original purchase price”, “country origin”, “collection value: low, med, high prices”, etc.

Update: 
As of 21 May 2025, the forced logout bug still exists.  One star.

Update:
18 June 2026, Discogs app is continuously getting better and way less finicky, but…..still kicks you off.  Just add FaceID and you’ll get that 5-star rating.

reviews.title: New App makes basic functions difficult
reviews.text:
Toggling wantlist and collection for items should be easy to do from the search results page, or from the item page. 

Instead, I have to do extra clicks and scroll down on every item page to find the buttons or see if things are in my collection.

I used to be able to use the app to quickly check if things were in my collection when I was shopping at the record store - no longer. I used to be able to search by barcode and quickly add the things I bought to my collection - no more. I used to be able to search and add things to wantlist quickly, which helped me shop on the website/app - no longer. 

It feels like the devs just built this app using a checklist, and didn't have any actual users test it for practical functions. Collection and wantlist toggles are CORE, BASIC functions. Make them easy to see any use, for the love of god PLEASE

reviews.title: App performs poorly and most sellers are scammers
reviews.text:
They recently overhauled the app (iPhone) and now the sort feature in collections works poorly. If you sort alphabetically, it will group all artists by starting letter but all of the artists/albums within that letter are just randomly ordered. If you sort by date, it will group all albums by the year they were added but all the results within that year are just in random order. I emailed Discogs about it but no replay and no change. They probably don’t care. 

80% of the sellers on Discogs drastically overrate their records. A record graded NM should play just about flawlessly. But most of the records I buy (typically NM) are full of noise and visual blemishes- this is after an ultrasonic cleaning/vacuuming. Buyer beware!

reviews.text: Only started using Discogs as perfect place to sell most formats. Thought i had set up everything correctly but having sold something today that hasn’t been the case. Not impressed and will be deleting app and selling stuff elsewhere.

reviews.title: Big bugs need fixing
reviews.text: I loved the old version of the app, but since the last update the logic in filters and collection ordering is massively broken, regrettably rendering the app almost unusable for me. There is no logic to how things are ordered other than artist beginning with A are in the A section but there is no ordering within that section.  There ceases to be any reference to the alphabet thereafter. Artist are not only not in order they are randomly mixed with other artist if you have multiple releases by the artists. Additionally you have started listing bands with the prefix 'the' in the T section. This doesn't work as the majority of collections now sit under T and with the above issues, is not intuitive and unusable. I want the Beatles to be listed under B, how it used to be and how you would find them in a record shop, Please please please revert to the old logic - it didn't need fixing and now it is massively broken. I am happy to provide more details to developers, if this would help getting a fix, although the problem is so big you must already be aware.

reviews.title: Phishing attacks
reviews.text: The developers have done something most developers don’t do, actually make the app worse. A great achievement in making an already poor app even less accessible than it was before. For example try searching for an album and adding certain filters, instead of REDUCING the options this app actually INCREASES them!! Absolute rubbish, if this app were a vinyl record it’d be Leo Sayer

reviews.title: No good for vinyls pre barcode
reviews.text: Collection screen keeps flashing on and off and no way to scan or photograph a vinyl that doesn’t have a barcode. Was looking for a way to catalog and value old records but this app does provide this function.

reviews.title: Terrible. Previous version was much better.
reviews.text: Please address the slow speed at which it refreshes while scrolling especially if you have a full basket. Being able to set the default on searches would make things much easier. Currency, cheapest item and format should all be set to the users preference and not have to be reset every search. More choices of search headings would be useful when digging in an individual seller’s store.

reviews.title: Can no longer login since update
reviews.text: The most recent update has made it so when I try to login, it errors out. Then, when clicking the “return to login page” it presents another error telling me the page is not secure. But, I click Proceed anyways, which just takes me back to that same error message page, never actually letting me type on my username/password. Very frustrating, since it clearly is just a browser running within the app, but it seems it just bee conflicting with my phone, even though I have deleted and reinstalled and reset my phone multiple times. I am running an iPhone 13 with iOS 26.2.

reviews.title: Clunky update
reviews.text:
Latest version needs sorting, very clunky and slow, did a search in my collection and  I gave up after it was still searching after a minute.

This used to be a great app.

reviews.title: Concept is good execution is old and clunky
reviews.text:
Every time I open it o have to remember my password. Some how this app manages not to work with iPhone password memory stuff. 

But mostly, please work with modern payment methods. Who the hell uses PayPal anymore? Apple Pay please!!

reviews.title: What’s happened
reviews.text:
Not liking new app, firstly I have no idea how to see messages from buyers or progress with sale. Only takes me to the item release page. Have started just using webpage on phone. 
I mostly use my laptop for discogs anyway and it’s easy to use and find way around. Will stick to that on phone if I need to use on the go.

reviews.title: Failure
reviews.text: Keeps dropping items out of collection and so have to repeatedly delete and reinstall app to reinstate collection list

reviews.title: Needs a lot of work
reviews.text: Getting worse.

reviews.title: New version is horrible
reviews.text: The new UI is really bad. The app is slow, my wantlist is no longer showing up or syncing, there are login issues, and everything just looks worse. No one asked for these changes. The worst change is when my wantlist actually loads, it no longer shows if those items are available on the marketplace. It used to show how many were available and the lowest price, but now it doesn’t show that info and I have to go to each item and dig until I find the listings. For rare items that sell quickly, this is a massive problem. Fix this app or bring back the old version.
